entries.display_title: Hody's Dark Secret! The Straw Hats' Arrival
entries.synopsis: Shirahoshi and Jinbe try to reach the captive Neptune. Hody reveals his role in the island's tragedy as the Straw Hats prepare their response.
entries.synopsis_basis: Self-authored concise story summary using the corresponding published Muhn Pace/One Pace story reference; no verbatim guide description imported.

correspondence_evidence.method: The exact live source filename identifies a V3 English-dubbed Fishman Island 15 release with manga chapters 632–633 and a corrected group shot. Those chapter tags agree with the published release record; inspected interior frames show the matching Hody/Straw Hat confrontation. These are two preserved file IDs for the same named variant, not two separate story edits.
correspondence_evidence.qualification: Derived coverage can include partial or rearranged original episodes. The reference release hashes are not asserted to equal this Pixeldrain file; filename/sequence/project correspondence is the basis, not a cryptographic identity claim.
